title: SECURE Sectio: study to monitor infections following cesarean birth at the University Hospital Bonn (UKB)
summary: Erfassung der Rate an postoperativen Wundinfektionen bei Patient*innen innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach einem Kaiserschnitt mithilfe von digitalen Online-Fragebögen

interventions.name:
All patients ≥ 18 years with caesarean birth at the University Hospital Bonn

Data items:
Day 0 = day of caesarean birth 
Data: age, smoking status, diabetes mellitus, adipositas, postal code (taken from clinical information system)
Follow-up at day 7, 14, 30 regarding wound infection(s), visit

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
mode of giving birth: caesarean birth
hospital: University Hospital Bonn (UKB)
Exclusion criteria:
patients < 18 years
no cesarean birth
not having given birth at UKB
no informed consent
central: Dr. med. Katharina Last · Institut für Hygiene und Öffentliche Gesundheit/ Public Health · +4922828753441 · katharina.last@ukbonn.de
